ValidationRule.description: Shift end must be after start, the shift length must match weekly hours / 5 within an hour, and shifts cannot start in the 22:00-05:59 window.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Shift_Start__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Shift_End__c)), OR( Shift_End__c <= Shift_Start__c, OR(HOUR(Shift_Start__c) >= 22, HOUR(Shift_Start__c) < 6), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Weekly_Hours__c)), ABS((HOUR(Shift_End__c) * 60 + MINUTE(Shift_End__c) - HOUR(Shift_Start__c) * 60 - MINUTE(Shift_Start__c)) / 60 - Weekly_Hours__c / 5) > 1) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Shift times are inconsistent with weekly hours.
